acceptance_criteria.description: Review mutation inputs trim body text, enforce rating 1–10 and body 10–2,000 code points, require a nonempty strict patch, and reject client-controlled fields.
Public Review projection exposes the approved fields and owning User projection adds only safe moderationState.
Review repository maps database naming to typed domain fields without leaking storage names.
